pr.title: docs: assemble ChatGPT Project upload set, thread primers, and repo map intake
pr.body:
## Summary
- Assemble a 40-file ChatGPT Project upload bundle for Dopemux Fast Dev OS.
- Add GPT-5.5 investigation intake handling.
- Add repo map/current workstream recon intake and digest.
- Add updated project setup, Thread 00 intake starter, and seven thread priming prompts.
- Add schema-valid Task Packet and proof metadata.

## Scope
Docs/package assembly only.
No runtime/source/config/test/dependency/CI changes.

## Validation
PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUN evidence must be copied from the final proof.

## Intake Artifacts
- GPT-5.5 investigation: report observed status.
- Repo map/current recon: report observed status.

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
List unresolved intake ambiguity and live GitHub/recon drift.

## Operator Notes
- Upload files from `UPLOAD_FILES/`.
- Attach `GPT55_INVESTIGATION_INTAKE.md`, `REPO_MAP_CURRENT_RECON.md`, and `REPO_MAP_DIGEST.md` to `00 Intake / Supervisor Ledger`.
- Use `OPERATOR_START_HERE.md` first.

@codex review
@gemini
@copilot

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch, status, marker, live authority files, schema, task packet index, Downloads candidates, and live GitHub PR posture.
validation: Repo identity must match DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp and .dopetaskroot must exist.
Any missing or conflicting authority must be recorded as UNKNOWN or CONFLICTING.

steps.task: Create this schema-valid Task Packet before package assembly.
Assemble the upload set, manifests, drift reports, intake files, repo-map digest, project setup, seven thread prompts, operator start file, and proof under the allowed out directory.
validation: UPLOAD_FILES must contain exactly 40 copied files.
Manifest must preserve source path, authority class, status, note, and sha256 for every upload file.
GPT-5.5 and repo-map intake statuses must be explicit.

steps.task: Create the zip archive and copy it to /Users/hue/Downloads when possible.
validation: Downloads copy status is COPIED, FAILED, or NOT_RUN in PROOF.json.

steps.task: Run final validation, inspect diff scope, codereview, precommit, commit, push, and open PR if authenticated.
validation: Packet and generated JSON files parse.
PR URL or exact blocker is reported.
